boiler_drum-v2.note: rho_floor and rho_floor_tracking follow the re-measured oracle hold (oracle audit: the planner plans on the mean noise, with a larger optimiser budget). They are the NEA reference: no reward reads them, so the environment's behaviour is unchanged. The boiler planner divides its objective by rho_floor_tracking, so its hold was re-measured under the new value (1.9204 against the 1.9194 set) and its rows re-recorded with it.
